cpi.label: CPI, all items, Metropolitan Lima, change on same month a year earlier (BCRP, PN01273PM, from INEI)

cpi_mom.label: CPI, all items, Metropolitan Lima, change on previous month, not seasonally adjusted (BCRP, PN01271PM)

policy_rate.label: BCRP reference rate (BIS central bank policy rates, M.PE, from September 2003)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, millions of soles at 2007 prices, not seasonally adjusted (BCRP, PN02538AQ)

gdp_growth_yoy.label: Real GDP growth, change on same quarter a year earlier, as published (BCRP, PN02507AQ)

exports.label: Exports of goods, FOB, US$ converted to soles at the BIS monthly average rate (BCRP trade balance, PN38714BM)

imports.label: Imports of goods, FOB, US$ converted to soles at the BIS monthly average rate (BCRP trade balance, PN38718BM)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports less imports, both FOB, soles (BCRP, converted at the BIS monthly average rate)

gdp_level.label: GDP, current prices, annual, from 1991 (World Bank)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, change on previous year (World Bank)

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate, ILO modelled estimate, annual (World Bank)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)
